name: The Helper
tagline: The Helper, the Caregiver or the Giver

items.label: Center of intelligence
items.value: Emotional (Heart).

items.label: Direction of use
items.value: Outward: focuses on the needs and feelings of others to define their identity.

items.label: Core issue
items.value: Identity and Image: the need to be loved and appreciated in order to feel they exist.

sections.title: Ego dynamics
sections.desc: Compulsion, passion, fixation, defense, ego pride, fear, desire.

items.label: Compulsion (Avoidance)
items.value: Avoiding acknowledgment of their own needs.

items.label: Passion (Vice)
items.value: Pride: believing oneself indispensable and without needs.

items.label: Fixation
items.value: Flattery: giving compliments and attention to ensure they are loved.

items.label: Defense mechanism
items.value: Repression: pushing down feelings or needs deemed unlovable.

items.label: Ego pride
items.value: I love, I help.

items.label: Basic fear
items.value: Being unworthy of love for who they are.

items.label: Basic desire
items.value: Feeling loved.

children.label: Self-preservation
children.value: Privilege (Me First): childlike charm to attract protection and advantages.

children.label: Social
children.value: Ambition: being indispensable/influential within groups or with powerful people.

children.label: One-to-one (Sexual)
children.value: Conquest: intense charm to captivate specific individuals.

items.label: Social style (Horneyan)
items.value: Compliant: approaches people according to the superego (one must help).

items.label: Conflict management (Harmonic)
items.value: Optimism: avoiding pain by focusing on the positive and on helping.

items.label: Wings
items.value: Wing 1 (more rigorous) and wing 3 (more ambitious and image-focused).

items.label: Integration (Growth)
items.value: → 4: more honest about their needs, introspective, authentic.

items.label: Disintegration (Stress)
items.value: → 8: angry, aggressive, domineering, vindictive.

sections.title: Spiritual identity and core
sections.desc: Holy Idea, virtue, aspect, core, child of the soul.

items.label: Holy Idea
items.value: Holy Will and Holy Freedom: the universe supports every being without manipulation.

items.label: Virtue
items.value: Humility: acknowledging one's limits and rightful place.

items.label: Idealized aspect
items.value: Merging Love / Merging Gold: an uninterrupted, nourishing divine connection.

children.label: Specific difficulty
children.value: Humiliating castration: not getting the support one needs.

children.label: Specific reaction
children.value: Willful action: wanting to do things one's own way to compensate.

children.label: Specific illusion
children.value: Separate will: believing in a will independent from the universe.

items.label: Child of the soul
items.value: The inner Little 4: a feeling of abandonment/specialness, learning to please in order to be loved.

items.label: Speaking style
items.value: Help-advice / Saga: unsolicited advice, relational stories.

items.label: Communication miscommunication
items.value: Love-Intrusion: what the 2 experiences as a gift can be perceived as an invasion.

items.label: Warning signs
items.value: Feeling indispensable, intrusive, complaints of exhaustion (martyrdom).

items.label: Growth practices
items.value: Saying no, solitude, identifying one's own needs before helping, accepting not being loved by everyone.

items.label: Frequent mix-ups
items.value: 4 (emotionality), 7 (optimism), 9 (merging).

children.label: In love
children.value: Very devoted; can become possessive and jealous when lacking recognition.

children.label: At work
children.value: Very good at support/networking; risk of favoritism.

levels.text: Selfless altruist, warm and nurturing presence.
Kind but starts to expect recognition.
Effusive friend, gets very involved, makes themselves indispensable.
Possessive intimate, intrusive, gives in order to receive.
Self-important saint, guilt-trips others, holds grudges.
Deceptive manipulator, emotional control, emotional blackmail.

items.label: Awareness
items.value: Moving from the helper's trance to self-remembering.

items.label: Spiral Dynamics
items.value: Often aligned with GREEN: empathy, consensus, the importance of relationships.

items.label: Analogy
items.value: An emotional gas station: fills others up while forgetting to refuel, until running on empty.
